```yaml
name: Agentics Maintenance
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  deduplicate-latest-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@1af3b93b6815bc44a9784bd300feb67ff0d1eeb3 # v4.1.0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@1e6005588af43841a05155179090055198903217 # v4.0.0
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd build-tools
          pnpm install

      - name: Extract duplicated code analysis
        id: extract_duplicated_code
        run: |
          # Find the duplicated code blocks
          echo "Finding duplicated code in build-cli commands..."
          
          # Extract the logic from both files
          grep -A 40 "const stableVersions.*filter.*semver.prerelease" build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts > /tmp/legacy_logic.txt
          grep -A 40 "const stableVersions.*filter.*semver.prerelease" build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts > /tmp/vnext_logic.txt
          
          # Compare the extracted code
          if cmp -s /tmp/legacy_logic.txt /tmp/vnext_logic.txt; then
            echo "DUPLICATED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "Duplicated code detected in both files"
          else
            echo "DUPLICATED=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "Code differs between files"
          fi

      - name: Create shared utility function
        if: env.DUPLICATED == 'true'
        run: |
          # Create a shared utility file for the common logic
          mkdir -p build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/utils
          
          cat > build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/utils/latestStableVersionChecker.ts << 'EOF'
          import { Command } from '@oclif/core';
          import semver from 'semver';

          export function checkLatestStableVersion(
            this: Command,
            version: string,
            versionList: string[]
          ): boolean {
            const stableVersions = versionList.filter((v) => !semver.prerelease(v)).sort(semver.rcompare);
            
            let shouldDeploy = false;
            for (const v of stableVersions) {
              if (semver.major(v) === semver.major(version)) {
                if (semver.eq(v, version)) {
                  this.log(`${version} is the latest stable version`);
                  shouldDeploy = true;
                } else {
                  this.log(
                    `${version} is NOT the latest stable version. A newer stable version exists: ${v}`,
                  );
                  shouldDeploy = false;
                }
                break;
              }
              this.log(`No stable version exists for major version ${semver.major(version)}.`);
              this.log(`${version} is the latest stable version`);
              shouldDeploy = true;
              break;
            }
            
            this.log(`##vso[task.setvariable variable=shouldDeploy]${shouldDeploy}`);
            return shouldDeploy;
          }
          EOF

          echo "Created shared utility function for latest stable version checking"

      - name: Update legacy command to use shared function
        if: env.DUPLICATED == 'true'
        run: |
          # Replace the duplicated logic in the legacy command
          sed -i '/const stableVersions.*filter.*semver.prerelease/,/##vso\[task.setvariable variable=shouldDeploy\]/d' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts
          
          # Add import and call to shared function
          sed -i '1i import { checkLatestStableVersion } from "../../utils/latestStableVersionChecker";' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts
          
          # Add the function call at the appropriate location
          sed -i '/this.log(`##vso\[task.setvariable variable=shouldDeploy\]${shouldDeploy}`);/i \
            checkLatestStableVersion.call(this, version, versionList);' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts

      - name: Update vnext command to use shared function
        if: env.DUPLICATED == 'true'
        run: |
          # Replace the duplicated logic in the vnext command
          sed -i '/const stableVersions.*filter.*semver.prerelease/,/##vso\[task.setvariable variable=shouldDeploy\]/d' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts
          
          # Add import and call to shared function
          sed -i '1i import { checkLatestStableVersion } from "../../../utils/latestStableVersionChecker";' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts
          
          # Add the function call at the appropriate location
          sed -i '/this.log(`##vso\[task.setvariable variable=shouldDeploy\]${shouldDeploy}`);/i \
            checkLatestStableVersion.call(this, version, allVersions);' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts

      - name: Verify changes
        if: env.DUPLICATED == 'true'
        run: |
          # Verify that the duplicated code is removed
          if grep -q "const stableVersions.*filter.*semver.prerelease" build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts; then
            echo "Legacy command still contains duplicated code"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if grep -q "const stableVersions.*filter.*semver.prerelease" build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts; then
            echo "VNext command still contains duplicated code"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Successfully removed duplicated code and replaced with shared function"

      - name: Commit changes
        if: env.DUPLICATED == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config --global user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/utils/latestStableVersionChecker.ts
          git add build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts
          git add build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts
          
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "chore: deduplicate latest stable version checking logic" || echo "No changes to commit"
          fi

      - name: Push changes
        if: env.DUPLICATED == 'true'
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref }}
```
